source_text: Ὡσαννὰ τῷ υἱῷ ∆αβὶδ εὐλογημένος· τὸ ἑβραικὸν οὕτως ἔχει ἐν τῷ ριζʹ ψαλμῷ· ΑΝΝΑ Α∆ΩΝΑΙ ΩΣΙΑΝΝΑ, Α∆ΩΝΑΙ ΑΣΛΙΑΝΝΑ, ΒΑΡΟΥΧ ΑΒΒΑ ΒΣΑΙΜ.
pass_a_gloss: Hosanna to the son of David blessed; the Hebrew thus has in the 117th psalm: ANNA ADONAI OSIANNA, ADONAI ASLIANNA, BAROUCH ABBA BSAIM.
pass_b_english: “Hosanna to the Son of David; blessed…” (Matthew 21:9) The Hebrew stands thus in Psalm 117: ANNA ADONAI OSIANNA, ADONAI ASLIANNA, BAROUCH ABBA BSAIM (Psalm 118:25–26).
